text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Lebanese continue to flee from Zaire after their belongings have been looted.
-Prime Minister Hariri left for Cairo for a meeting with President Mubarak.
-An Israeli force entered the village of Arnoun just inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone and arrested five Lebanese citizens.
-Lebanon Invest Group raised its capital to $40 million from $26 million.
-Greenpeace accuses some Lebanese factories of polluting the sea and some rivers.
-One Israeli soldier killed, three wounded, in Hizbollah raid in south Lebanon.
-The trial of the five Japanese Red Army suspects held in Beirut is due to open at the start of April.
-Lebanon's military prosecutor charged five Lebanese with collaborating with Israel.
